result.summary: The home feed renders cleanly overall, but the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab: "Profile" is shown as active (green) while the screen displayed is the Home feed. No other clear visual defects were found; the clipped carousel items and the cut-off pizza card are expected scroll behavior.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar shows "Profile" as the active tab (green icon and bold green label), while the screen content is clearly the Home feed (delivery address, promo banner, restaurant lists). The Home tab is rendered in inactive grey.
issues.suggestion: Bind the active tab state to the current route so that Home is highlighted on the home feed, and Profile is only highlighted when the Profile screen is displayed.
